objective: BCEWithLogitsLoss, train-only positive weight (12845/539) when weighted, otherwise 1
normalisation: Shared NumPy float32 preprocessing; custom symmetric grayscale and MobileNet replicated grayscale with ImageNet channel statistics; preserve 256x256

data_loader.augmentation: Horizontal/vertical flips for declared augment=True; validation has no augmentation

checkpoint_rule: Within a training run: best validation F2, tie lower validation loss. Across candidates: F2, AP, fewer parameters.
metadata_trained_steps_note: This field counts completed run updates; selected_epoch/history identify how many updates produced the saved selected weights. It is not an exact selected-checkpoint update counter.
